description:
2026 Topps 75th Anniversary Baseball - 10 Card Rookie Lot

All ten cards carry the MLB Rookie Card logo. You will receive the exact cards pictured - these are photos of the actual lot, not stock images.

- Jeremiah Jackson - Baltimore Orioles, Second Baseman (RC)
- Lazaro Estrada - Toronto Blue Jays, Pitcher (RC)
- Brandyn Garcia - Arizona Diamondbacks, Pitcher (RC)
- Travis Adams - Minnesota Twins, Pitcher (RC)
- Ryan Ritter - Colorado Rockies, Shortstop (RC)
- Nathan Church - St. Louis Cardinals, Outfielder (RC)
- Didier Fuentes - Atlanta Braves, Pitcher (RC)
- Pierson Ohl - Minnesota Twins, Pitcher (RC)
- Carson Seymour - San Francisco Giants, Pitcher (RC)

Nine teams represented: Arizona Diamondbacks, Atlanta Braves, Baltimore Orioles, Colorado Rockies, Minnesota Twins, Philadelphia Phillies, San Francisco Giants, St. Louis Cardinals, Toronto Blue Jays.

Condition: Pack-fresh and handled by the edges from the moment they came out. Sharp corners, clean surfaces, no creases or print lines noted. Centering varies card to card as it does in any pack - please judge from the photos.

Shipping: Every card goes in a penny sleeve, into a top loader, inside a bubble mailer with cardboard backing. Combined shipping on multiple purchases - just ask before paying.
